**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 24 satisfies the ASSIGN preferred position on every material term:

- **24.1** — Customer may assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent (prompt notice + assignee assumption only).
- **24.2** — Vendor is restricted asymmetrically in our favour: no assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent, and never to a direct Customer competitor.
- **24.3** — applies only to "other assignments" (those outside 24.1/24.2), on a mutual not-unreasonably-withheld standard, so it does not undercut our carve-out.
- **24.4** — expressly bars any Vendor right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service on our change of control.
- **13.3** — consistent, allowing licence rights to transfer with a permitted Section 24 assignment.

None of the walk-away triggers (blanket Customer assignment bar, Vendor CoC termination/re-pricing right) are present.
